{{Quote|Hey, I just got out of prison. If we had a decent navicomputer, trust me, we'd be dropping out of hyperspace into the Nar Shaddaa Red Sector right now.|[[Atton Rand]] to [[Meetra Surik|the Exile]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
The '''Red Light Sector''' was an area of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] known for its illicit entertainment.

It offered services such as bodily enhancements, implants, and other options for adrenaline junkies. Alongside the surgical and bio-enhancement shops, other shady businesses, in particular [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] and [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dealers, offered various products. They took advantage of the wealth, desperation or moral flexibility, that visitors to the Red Light Sector brought with them.

Though [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] security did secure the central area of the Sector for tourists, other areas were filled with crime and the Cartel Security warned visitors of entering those zones; though they did little to stop the violence itself.
